intro: Redmond Tech Orchestra brings people together through the shared experience of live orchestral music. Through community performances, cultural celebrations, educational outreach, and student mentorship, we create opportunities for audiences, young musicians, and community organizations across the Eastside to connect, learn, and be inspired.

Our members volunteer their time and talent to enrich community life, support the next generation of musicians, and make high-quality orchestral music accessible to more people. From neighborhood events and civic celebrations to school partnerships and side-by-side learning experiences, we use music to strengthen the connections that make our community thrive.
